contexts: regional admission data from three public hospitals
reading: The exposure is observable at discharge and the outcome in regional admission data, so the question is answerable from existing records. Frailty sits upstream of both exposure and outcome, and indications such as incontinence and depression carry their own fall risk; the conflicting leads differ on exactly these two paths. Exposure drifts after 30 days. The recorded search found nothing, so every evidence node below is an unchecked lead.
